description:
Join our “Tango experience” and discover the magic of embraces while you enjoy drinks in great secret venues in the center of Barcelona..
An unique way of meeting people, having fun, experience a local life-style, learn something new and embrace!
Great for couples, groups, solo travelers and team building!

- First, relax and enjoy drinks in a charming place meanwhile we introduce each other and discover a little about tango. (20-30 minutes)

- Then, a very dynamic lesson of Tango Argentino with professional dancers, no need any experience! We will introduce you to the essence of tango. We’ll guide you through the basic elements while discovering, little by little, the magic of communicating within an embrace, using gentle movements. Even if you think you have 2 left feet, you will dance!!! (40-50 minutes)

- During the experience we'll take photos and videos! We’ll share them at the end.

* To consider:
- Afternoon sessions: great for solo travelers, couples, teams.
- Morning sessions: ideal for couples, groups, team building.
- If you're a solo traveller, contact us before booking to suggest you the best day to join.
- The experience in total is around 1.15 hours. We won’t open doors after 10 minutes of the starting time to respect the other guests. Please check with time instructions to arrive.
- With rain, lesson indoors
locationDescription:
We open the doors of magical venues of the city. A modernist house with a lovey terrace, a secret garden like an oasis or a lovely rooftop in the Gothic.
In all of our spaces we'll do our best to make you feel at home. In case of rain, we have indoor space

We had a great time sharing the tango experience with Ana Paula and her husband. Great rooftop, amazing homemade sangria (unlimited) and lovely vibes

What can I say? The hosts were welcoming, funny and entertaining. The way they teach is fun and clear. The rooftop is magical and even the sea gulls had a lot to say. Even if you think you can't dance or don't particularly like it, this experience will change your mind. Ana Paula and George are excellent teachers and they give so much more than just the class - plus you get sent more so you can practice at home. I thoroughly recommend anyone to do this experience.

Let me start by saying that my wife and I have never taken a dance lesson before, and I have two left feet, so I was a bit apprehensive about a dance lesson and Tango sounded intimidating. I know it was just the very basics and a few steps, but I was worried I would not even be able to remember that, but the way you and your husband demonstrated, explained and critiqued made it so easy. Also the connection the two of you share and the humor made the experience even better. We can't thank you enough for the experience and it gave us the confidence to work on the Tango more and become better at it! Thank you again!
It was one of the most beautiful experiences I have tried during my visit in Barcelona. Paula is just the best and she is super cool. The experience was so much fun that i didn’t want it to end.

It was reallly fun with Ana. She instantly made the entire group comfortable and has a great way of breaking down steps! Anyone can learn to dance with these two!! Also they made sure that the sangria glass is never empty :p

Paula and her partner both have amazing energy! Though my hubby and I were utter beginners, we didn't feel intimidated at all. We felt comfortable and just had fun with it! She also sent some material to us after so that we could look more into Tango and brush up on a few of the moves. The pics at the end were also very appreciated!

An incredibly beautiful experience! We had no dance experience at all, but we were still able to do it superbly. From start to finish it was super organized and really was a lot of fun! An absolute MUST in Barcelona!!! In addition, you got free video and pictures of yourself! Great hosts, thank you very much Paula and Jorge! ♥️

Had the best time at Paula’s place! They made us both feel very welcome and were very encouraging. The environment was comfortable and fun and their passion for the dance is so lovely to see, we will definitely be practicing at home!
This experience is amazing! The hosts are absolutely incredible and so welcoming!! It was such a fun and welcoming environment and I highly recommend do this if you are in Barcelona!!
Both hosts are super funny and charming. Even if your legs are made out of wood, you'll end up dancing tango at the end of the experience

Ana Paula and Jorge were wonderful teachers and obviously great people! Had a wonderful time dancing on their rooftop terrace, meeting new people, drinking sangria and dancing!!! Definitely recommend!!
So much fun!! Me and my friends all had an amazing time learning how to tango. A very unique and worthwhile experience if you have the time!

This experience far exceeded expectations. From someone who has no experience in dancing, I fell in love with Tango. Ana and George were amazing, welcoming and very funny. If you are reading reviews stop, just book. You won’t regret it.

Thank you for such a lovely experience! We enjoyed ourselves a lot. Ana Paula and Jorge were amazing hosts. It was such a unique experience too, wish we had a little more time to do more dancing at the end! But all in all it was a MUCH Recommended experience. Gracias

Our hosts welcomed us with a drink and a smile, talked through the history of tango and helped us get an intro. We started knowing nothing and ended with a whole dance sequence under our belts. Would definitely recommend
The whole experience was amazing! Ana is a great host and the class was very fun. Felt very comfortable the whole time and even learnt some new moves

what a brilliant morning out. Such fun and a fantastic teacher who was encouraging and funny. This was one of the best things we did in Barcelona and would definitely return if we come to Barcelona again.Thank you Ana!

This was a pleasure to take part in at Ana Paula’s tango lesson. She was very kind and professional person. Tango by her and her partner Jorge was great, both are amazing teachers. There was a lot of laughing and fun. I really recommend it 🤩

Went into this with high expectations. I wish this class had been more relaxed. My boyfriend and I both felt uncomfortable in the class. The host made a lot of jokes trying to be funny and lighthearted but we felt maybe she could have toned it down as they weren’t super nice jokes lol. We both felt on edge the entire class—if we make a wrong step we worried we would be targeted. However, the tango itself was quite fun and now we know the basics of a tango!
Such a fun activity to do while in Barcelona. Ana is a great host and welcomes you with sangria and is very friendly. If you aren’t a good dancer, they make you feel like one!

Great experience - something different to do and both hosts were so welcoming and friendly! It felt really fun and laid back whilst also learning something new. A lovely way thing to do as a couple, with friends or to meet new people if you wanted to. Highly recommend.

Ana Paula and his husband were absolutely GORGEOUS and very funny. We had great time with them and whole group was excited including the bride who probably is going to dance tango at her wedding ;) They were hospitable, the place is beautiful and they left us some tips to learn more about the topic of the lesson. I would do it again immediately, maybe I would have appreciated a slightly longer session to have more lesson time

Paula and George provided such a welcoming environment and made a solo traveler like me feel comfortable. Whether you have zero dance experience or have danced your whole life, you’ll enjoy the class! Paula and George offer plenty of other surprise “extras” as well. Definitely take their class! 🤩
Highly recommend! Ana Paula and her husband are incredibly warm and friendly, and great storytellers. No dance experience needed at all! Lots of fun, and a great experience.

Paula and her partner were AMAZING teachers and people! I had a great time with my husband learning a little bit about Argentina and Tango :) They both magical dancer experts at helping everyone have a good time and let go of dancing anxieties. It was obvious they both took time and effort to plan out how the teaching would go and it showed. The pictures and videos they took of us were so great and Paula even gave us some documentary suggestions for further Tango(ing)! Highly recommend - even no zero dance experience you'll go on a fun adventure.
I was hesitant at first when my wife signed us up but this is worth it! The lesson is at a great location and Ana does a great job of explaining it and breaking it down so it is easy.
This tango lesson was so much fun! The gist and her husband were hilarious and great teachers. They created a relaxed environment where we could be ourselves while learning the steps.

This experience was amazing! Super approachable lessons for non-dancers and an amazing view from the rooftop. Easily the highlight of my barcelona trip. Paula took photos and videos and the sangria was flowing! Will remember forever.

We had a great time with Paula and Gorge in their rooftop apartment. They’re a fun, charming couple and helped make everyone feel welcome and relaxed. We appreciated the sangria and enjoyed meeting other guests from around the world. We really enjoyed their hospitality and we even learned a little tango.

Paula and Jorge did a great job of making their guest feel at ease and introducing the dance steps in increments that were easy to follow. Their playfulness and obvious affection for each other helped make the experience a delight.
My friend and I had an amazing time learning how to tango on the rooftop. I would recommend to anyone who is looking to understand the basics of tango and enjoy the views of Barcelona.

This was an excellent start to an evening; well organized and a lot of fun! No experience necessary. The hosts made sure everyone was comfortable and moved at a good pace. Highly recommend for a fun and unique experience.

Great experience! Our group was new to Tango and Paula did a wonderful job making us all comfortable with dance. We all enjoyed it a lot, and would highly recommend to anyone! The instructors were a beautiful couple and very kind & funny

Ana paula and her partner were so fun and funny! She made the entire experience of tango so accessible and fun. It was really such a wonderful activity and all the other couples were also great! We really enjoyed!
Ana Paola and Jorge were wonderful hosts and teachers! I would recommend this experience to anyone in Barcelona whether you come with a partner or not (I didn't).
A beautiful rooftop setting with the most warm, hilarious hosts. A very welcoming environment for complete beginners to dance. My mum and I had a great time!

Ten friends on a weekend trip, we had the greatest time on Ana Paulas roof! Even the most hesitant ones in our group were won over. She is a wonderful teacher, clearly knows her tango and shares generously - regardless how little elegance you bring to the floor.

Ana & Her husband were absolutely amazing hosts. They were great at making everyone comfortable & quickly acquainted, and friendly with the drinks! Definitely an experience worth trying for yourself :)

I found that Paula was really committed to making the experience fun for everyone. She has a great sense of humor and she is best at making everyone comfortable.

Generally I had lots of fun and enjoyed the evening to the fullest. I highly recommend it to solo travellers like myself to meet new people and have a fun evening while learning Tango :)

must-have experience! We felt confident, laughed, talked to other guests. Jorge is a sacred dancer, we shared more than a pleasant time. It was perfect, we received a small video to see our performance.
not to be missed!

This tango class was a great experience! We learned a simple and doable combination for both new and experienced dancers. Hosts were incredibly inviting and provided a wonderful experience.

Would definitely recommend this as a great date night activity in Barcelona - this was for sure one of the highlights in our vacation here!
This experience was awesome. It was a great opportunity to meet people and engage in something new. Ana and her husband were awesome and very welcoming :)
Highly recommend this fantastic tango experience in Barcelona. Ana Paula and Jorge were great - we all really enjoyed learning to tango with these incredible dancers.

I really loved my experience! The dancing was fun and low pressure and I had such a great group. My partner ended up bailing last minute, but I luckily wasn’t the only solo dancer there and was to participate and make a new friend. Highly recommend!
We had a lot of fun and the hour went by really fast! We learned some basics and it was a great taster lesson. Would definitely recommend it if you haven't tried out tango yet!

Absolutely loved this experience. So thoughtful and personalized as well as Paula treating us like friends not strangers. My only complaint is I wish it was longer! Not much you can really learn in the short amount of time. Though I came in expecting not to be an A1 tango star by the end. I would have paid extra to stay a bit longer. Truly a special woman with great talent. Awesome for a date night or spending extra time with your mom/family member that might want to learn a few moves. If you’re coming alone fear not you will still have an amazing time!
Paula does an amazing job making everyone feel welcomed, I was surprised to see how much we learned and bonded in such a short time. A great way to end my time in Barcelona.
We had THE BEST time. We were welcomed in such a warm manner, learned much more than we expected and had tons of laughs. Don't hesitate and book this experience :)
Absolutely fantastic experience - from someone whose partner is a dancer but who has two left feet, they made me feel totally comfortable and even a bit proud of myself!
We loved learning how to tango taught by Paula and George. They were so friendly and encouraging, even though we had no dance experience. Highly recommend for couples or friends.

The tango lesson with Ana Paula was amazing and not to be missed! Ana Paula was very personable and such a fantastic teacher, not to mention her great rooftop location. This was a fun way to try something new while on vacation and to chat with other tourists!

We had so much fun learning to tango with Ana Paula!! She was so kind, patient, and informative and the pictures and videos she took of us were absolutely amazing! This is definitely a must try while in Barcelona! It was a highlight of our trip!!

Magic location and magical teaching skills, Ana will make the whole group feel like a group of friends and will also give broad yet specific tips and directions so that you feel comfortable that you’re getting the most out of the experience. Wonderful location to spend some time learning, laughing and enjoying tango dancing. It is very pleasant and enjoyable and Ana Paula makes the experience comfortable and attractive. No downsides!

Highly recommend for people with 2 left feet! Paula was welcoming, informative, and funny. She sent us the choreography following the class so we could continue practicing. Her flat is in a perfect location for grabbing drinks and lunch after.
Ana is a character! ❤️ we liked her “at hello” . I recommend it with all my heart and the location is magical!
Highly recommend! Ana Paula & husband were so welcoming and very nice people! My friend and I felt super comfortable attending a lesson and wish there could’ve been a second one!

What a fun experience! Paula and Jorge were fabulous teachers and hosts. We loved dancing on their beautiful garden terrace and they had us laughing our way joyously through the lesson! We can confidently say we loved every minute of this experience!

I had the most wonderful time at this class! My girlfriend and I went together and it was a blast. Paula and Jorge were fantastic teachers and very welcoming hosts, and their sangria was delicious. would recommend to anyone
i loved this, one of the best things we did in Barceona- Paula was amazing, value so good, i would recommend everyone to do this

A MUST DO. This was the sweetest, most wonderful experience, a cannot miss. Paula could not have been kinder or done a better job, the location was gorgeous, we had so much fun, and they even sent us home with resources to continue our tango learning at home! Truly, this experience could not have been more perfect. Do not miss this on your trip to Barcelona!!

We had a fantastic time. Even my partner who was very sceptical before coming absolutely loved it in the end! Plus in 1 session you learn the basics that are enough to be able to able to dance tango :)

This was an amazing experience! My wife and I often Visit Barcelona and decided on giving the class a shot.
The class exceeded all expectations the Roof top class is one in the bucket list that wasn’t even there.

If you have 2 hours 2 meet new friends, see great sites and to smile kick off your vacation/holiday with Tango

They are an amazing Duo. We can’t wait to go back and drop in once again.

Viv and Rae

What a lovely, memorable night my Mom and I had with Ana! Her thoughtful words, undeniable passion for tango and welcoming heart made the experience something I will hold very dearly. Thank you Ana for welcoming us into your oasis and giving us a new perspective of Gotic and tango. Last but not least, thanks to you partner for the excellent sangria - much needed liquid courage before the lesson began!

Wow! What an amazing experience! Ana and George were so welcoming! Ice cold sangria set on a beautiful rooftop overlooking the city with views of the cathedral and the sagrada familia. Ana was an amazing host and a brilliant teacher - she knew everyone’s names and the dancing was great fun. She takes some great videos and photos and her stories are fascinating. One of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona!

The experience was amazing from start to finish! We were given detailed instructions from the door to our goodbyes to avoid any confusion. The dance lessons were perfect for my beginner level of experience and they really made sure you felt confident in your dance but still having fun if it wasn’t perfect. I loved every second of this experience! So happy to have these awesome memories! I highly recommend!

This was an amazing experience! I surprised my wife with this experience for an anniversary gift and we had such a great time. Paula was a wonderful teacher and was so friendly. My wife and I were the only ones who attended our particular lesson, but Paula was able to make it fun and funny and lively all the same. I'm not much of a dancer myself, but I had so much fun! Can't recommend it enough!

Ana and George know what they do, and they do it very well. They're passionate about dancing and sharing their love for tango.
They know how to talk to you and push you out of your comfort zone when you're someone as shy and bad dancer as I am.
So I'm glad I've met them and they could teach me few steps.
If you have this opportunity, just do it. It's worthy , I recommend it !

Paula’s and Jorge were great instructors! They weren’t only great instructors, they were also funny and made the learning really fun. Additionally, they sent each of us all the pictures and videos taken throughout the class. At the end, they also sent all of us a plethora of information and media so we can continue learning.

Omg!! So much fun for our last day in Barcelona. We felt very comfortable and learned a whole dance and got great information to continue dancing at home if we want :) sangria to cool us off & love the instructors so kind and funny!!

Excellent value for what you pay! Paula and Jorge were wonderful. So lively and clearly passionate about dance. They do a great job at engaging the crowd and making everyone feel confident and included regardless of any dance experience. They also were great at encouraging connections with others in the class so it was a nice way to make new friends!

Amazing experience, we ended our trip in a glorious way by attending this Tango Lesson. It was so much fun to learn all the steps and practice the dancing routine and we loved to interract with all our fellow participants! It's definetly something you don't wanna miss! <3

We had such an amazing time with everyone! We expected to be in our bubble, but ended up making a ton of new friends and breaking out of our comfort zones. So much fun and fantastic instructors. Our most memorable moment of our Barcelona trip!

So much fun, the hosts were so welcoming and friendly and instantly put the whole group at ease breaking the ice!

The dance was simple to follow and we had lots of laughs. 100% recomend to someone who want to try something new and connect with their partner.

Don’t think just go! Enjoy drinks with a spectacular view as Paula and her husband make you feel right at home, in their home. Within a few steps you will feel like a natural! Paula and her husband are funny and kind, they truly are the life of the party. So if you’re a group or solo traveler don’t be afraid, go and join the fun!!
Loved my experience w Ana and her husband it was relaxing and so much fun it just added that extra sparkle to my trip

We unfortunately had to cancel day of, but the communication was very well done! Detailed instructions day of, and prior communication was helpful and informative. We were sad we missed the class, and. meeting them.

Great great event to add to going to Barcelona! I would definitely do this again and recommend to any friend spending a few nights near gothic quarter. Paula was so nice and such a great teacher. It was so fun getting to dance with a bunch of fellow travelers.
Such a lovely place!! The location and lessons were amazing and it was great to meet other tourists in the area. Awesome time <3

What a great experience! We recommend everyone to do this. The activity was very straightforward, the dancing was very nice. Nice reception with drinks, we had a cozy group and Ana Paula and her husband are very nice and funny. A very nice afternoon on a Spanish roof terrace and an experience richer.
Fantabulous experience. Ana Paula and Jorge were great hosts and good teachers. If I land in Barcelona, I'll be back for more lessons.
Very fun (even for those who can't dance)! The teaching environment was relaxed and accommodating, and Paula and her partner were both very welcoming.

I'm a dancer and my partner is not, but we both enjoyed the tango lesson so much! The instructors were very fun and encouraging. They took photos and videos of us during the lesson. What a great memory to bring home with us!
You definitely need to do this! The guys had fun too! We all laughed a lot. Ana Paula and George were so funny, we enjoyed meeting them and everyone laughed a lot! You come away learning to Tango!!!

Such a fun experience! Signing up for this was definitely outside of our comfort zone, but so glad we took a chance bc had a great time and made a lot of memories! The sangria / drinks offered helped to feel more relaxed, the rooftop was beautiful, and Paula and her partner were so kind, fun, and welcoming. She took photos and videos throughout which she shared at the end along with links for further information, songs, etc. A great touch!
Amazing and encouraging hosts that make you feel very welcome and comfortable in something that doesn't always come naturally for some people. It is a lovely venue and was great fun!

Paula and her partner were amazing hosts and we received a warm welcome with a glass of sangria. The lesson was so much fun! Paula is a great story teller that made everyone laugh. Super fun class and very educational. Paula does a great job to point out if you’re learning and she makes sure you enjoy getting it right. Everyone seemed to enjoy the class. Sangrias we’re store bought and very tasty.
Great experience , very nice , the very nice teacher, superb place everything was perfect I recommend this moment for couples 😁

it was an amazing experience! Paula and Jorge are great hosts and teachers. I do recommend booking this experience, whether you're a solo traveler like I am or you discover Barcelona
with your partner, family or friends. :)

We always loved to dance, and learn how to improve, and booked this lesson since the location was amazing.
What a wonderful surprise it was to discover the amazing couple Paula and Jorge.

This is a must!!!

This class sounded so fun and I conceived my boyfriend to do it with me. He was hesitant to go because it was a dance class. LOVED LOVED this experience. 10/10 would recommended:) We had so much fun and they really made us feel welcomed. They were very funny and made sure everyone was included. A must do if you are in Barcelona!!

this was such a fun activity and the hosts are phenomenal at making everyone feel comfortable and included. the rooftop is truly lovely, and the instructors really made us feel welcome. my only complaint was that I wish the class were longer!

Thank you so much for a wonderful experience this evening. As a solo traveller I was a little apprehensive but you both made me feel so welcome that I certainly did not feel the odd one out. Gayle💃🏽🕺🏽

Great and unique experience! Paola is very hospitable, cheerful person, very eager to share her passion for tango. We highly recommend these classes for couples visiting Barcelona as well as for solo travelers who want to meet other people in a fun way. 10/10!

My husband and I took this class today and has such a fun time!! Ana Paula and her partner were so welcoming, talented, and funny. They made the entire experience so enjoyable from start to finish. Lovely atmosphere, we were offered a drink on arrival and giving a quick introduction on the dance class. It was a good bonding experience for all friends or partners
Great experience for novices! Paula and Jorge hosted us perfectly and were great dance teachers while sharing their passion, the place was magical and we were wonderfully welcomed. Thank you again.
Paula was so charming and funny. Such a lovely host and teacher. You'll feel welcome by a longtime friend and leave feeling energized and with a new routine :)
The most wonderful one hour I spent in Barcelona! Paula and her husband are accomplished storytellers and gracious hosts. I walked away in awe of tango and eager to learn more. Thank you dear Paula!

this was probably the best 1.5 hour class you could ever expect to receive in tango for an amateur learner. Paula and husband were very patient, kind, fun, upbeat, and know how to teach tango. great overall experience... want to continue lessons! highly recommended

Really friendly hosts and welcoming atmosphere, the lesson catered to complete beginners but still finished with a sense of accomplishment in our tango skills. The sangria refills were also appreciated and added to the authenticity of the experience :)

If you're visiting Barcelona, don't miss the tango lesson! The host and her husband provided us with drinks and brought us closer to the tango step by step. It was a lot of fun, especially because both are totally fun and lively!!

Wow!! What an amazing experience. One of my favorite things we have done in Barcelona so far. Perfect for a couple or a group of friends. The personal touches with photos and videos was above and beyond. Lots of dancing, laughter, and learned a lot about Tango as well. 10/10! Muchas gracias!
Great experience!! Thank you so much for hosting Ana Paula and her partner, they gave us the taste of the tango! I highly recommend it, go there without so much as a second thought!

The tango lesson was an exceptional experience, learned some great moves and a bit of history behind this lovely dance all thanks to Ana Paula and her partner. Thank you so much for the sangria and for having us!

I couldn’t recommend more for a fun date with a friend or partner.
An experience you don't want to miss! Great hosting, very friendly. Magical place. Ana Paula and her partner are very educational .
My boyfriend and I loved this experience, it was so fantastic and something we will remember for a long time!! Definitely worth doing

The next class, where we'll definitely be better, thanks to you
It was a beautiful experience, in a span of one hour we learnt some basics movements and had great learnings about the dance form
Super fun experience. You don’t need to be an expert dancer for this! Ana is a great teacher and the dance is super fun.

Exceptional experience! We went with a group of 5 girl, none of us with any dance experience. We had so much fun. Paula and Jorge did an amazing job to teach us a super fun routine. We had a lot of laughs and just a very special time. It was one of our highlights!

Highly recommend!!!!!! Do this ! It is worth every cent!
Super fun! It was an absolutely gorgeous view, new friends and awesome instructors! I was honestly surprised about what we could learn in the time!

We loved how energetic and passionate Ana Paula and Jorge were from when they greeted us at the front door and throughout the dance lesson. We enjoyed being welcomed with drinks and appreciating the sun on the rooftop. Thanks for a super fun time!

Me and my friend have absolute no experience in dancing at all but just wanted to give something new a go. Ana made us feel so welcome straight away. Everything about it was perfect. It's not hard for beginners to learn at all. Teachers are delightful, and you and Shangria and you and Shangria and you and Shangria will learn to get to know the barcelona sunset and the basics of the tango. I definitely recommend you to try it!! 😃
Super fun experience. Hosts are very friendly and talented. Really recommend trying this out if you want to have unique dance class with a partner while in town.
Absolutely fantastic! Paula and Jorge are so personable and fun 🤩 such good value for money - would 100% recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona

This was the best part of our entire trip to Barcelona. Ana Paula and her partner beam with the kindness we were told Barcelona is known for. Beyond the drinks, they shared photography talents, wisdom, and laughs.
